subject: NCC
instruction: Explain the pedagogical scope, core concepts, and assessment objectives for Search and Rescue in CBSE Class 11 NCC.
expected_response: Under CBSE Class 11 NCC (076), Unit-7: Search and Rescue covers fundamental foundational principles aligned with NEP 2020 competency-based learning framework. Learners are evaluated on conceptual understanding, problem-solving application, and analytical rigor.
